blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday urged foreign manufacturers to invest in the Philippines’ electric vehicle (EV) industry as the government aims to have EVs account for 50% of the country’s vehicle fleet by 2040. He made the call during a visit to the manufacturing and assembly plant of Sazgar Philippines Inc. in Biñan City, Laguna. READ: Marcos pushes for local production of Filipino-made e-jeeps, e-tricycles Established in 2026, Sazgar Philippines Inc. is a subsidiary of Pakistan-based Sazgar Engineering Works Ltd.
